lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the spot columns, forming distinct anchor nodes where they intersect with the horizontal rows of spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two parallel horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs; approximately five distinct spots are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located in the lower-posterior region.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller fish (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral and lower flank surfaces below the pectoral fin.
